## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: pervasive sector weakness (9/11 sectors negative) and major large-cap weakness with AAPL (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -4.83%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.46% | 1M: -4.16%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -8.08%) BELOW TREND; Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5). Major divergence present — several large names in RECOVERY while megacaps remain below trend; treat as tactical, not regime-proof.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +13.74%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +4.02% | 1M: +20.39%) ABOVE TREND. Financials show relative strength: WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY, GS (1W: +4.00% | 1M: -10.78%) RECOVERY, MS (1W: +4.26% | 1M: -7.40%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: CEG (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND, EXC (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -1.10%) BELOW TREND. Materials weak: FCX (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -16.75%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -12.58% | 1M: -23.45%) BELOW TREND. Industrials/Consumer also broadly negative (BA (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%) BELOW TREND).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +4.55% | 1M: -3.45%) RECOVERY, SLB (1W: +4.27% | 1M: -9.53%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5), style leaning Value/Cyclical.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CEG (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -8.59%) BELOW TREND, SBUX (1W: -6.66% | 1M: -3.39%) BELOW TREND, EXC (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -1.10%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Utilities/Healthcare/Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +4.55% | 1M: -3.45%) RECOVERY, MS (1W: +4.26% | 1M: -7.40%) RECOVERY — note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: multiple big names showing 1W up / 1M down pattern.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but weak overall: AAPL (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -4.83%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.46% | 1M: -4.16%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -8.08%) BELOW TREND while chip equipment names LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY and AMAT (1W: +4.55% | 1M: -3.45%) RECOVERY flash short-term bounces — sector 1W: -0.76% (24 stocks) and showing internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials relatively resilient: WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY, GS (1W: +4.00% | 1M: -10.78%) RECOVERY, JPM (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -6.98%) RECOVERY but many 1M negatives; sector 1W: +0.84% (20 stocks) — mixed but supportive of cyclical/value tilt.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare pressured: LLY (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -8.59%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND with few exceptions (PFE (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +0.41%) ABOVE TREND); sector 1W: -2.47% (17 stocks) — defensive names not leading.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and selective Financials for tactical exposure (OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +13.74%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to high-beta mega-cap growth that remain BELOW TREND (NVDA (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -8.08%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.46% | 1M: -4.16%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical favored, but major divergence calls for caution and position sizing discipline.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +13.74%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: LLY (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -12.58% | 1M: -23.45%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.90% | 1M: +10.31%) — watch leaders holding 1M trend. BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -3.80%), Materials (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -10.87%) — downside pressure likely to persist.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor whether Energy leaders sustain 1M gains (OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) hold above recent 1M range) as confirmation of sector-led risk-off rallies; watch NVDA (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -8.08%) failure to reclaim short-term trend as confirmation of ongoing BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -4.83%) holding/breaching recent lows would deepen market risk-off.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+75): Positive trial headline but price is diverging — LLY (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND (news bullish, price falling = distribution). OXY appears supported despite bearish headlines elsewhere but OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND (news mixed, price confirming strength). VST (+60): sentiment positive but VST (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -15.24%) BELOW TREND (news bullish, price diverging).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CEG (-50): downgrade headline confirming weakness — CEG (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND (sentiment confirmed). WMT (-50): macro warning aligns with price — WMT (1W: -5.73% | 1M: -4.49%) BELOW TREND (sentiment confirmed). MA (-50): regulatory/legal pressure — MA (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -4.60%) BELOW TREND (sentiment adds risk).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with a Value/Cyclical tilt. OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +13.74%) ABOVE TREND and select Financials (WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY) are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence — several recovery rallies among mid‑caps while megacaps (NVDA, MSFT, AAPL) remain BELOW TREND and bullish news (e.g., LLY +75) is not translating into price confirmation.
